scope: Proposition 2.4 (Transport of uncertainty) of the manuscript “L1 Embeddings of Graphs of Bounded Treewidth” (preprints/L1-Embeddings-of-Graphs-of-Bounded-Treewidth-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 089 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 13276d0ab77859c5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 8. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let µ be a consistent family of symmetric bag measures, with bags of size at most k. Consider the path B0, . . . , Br from a bag containing y to a bag containing z, and let P = Bj lie on this path. Suppose a labeled cut measure ν on V satisfies ν|Bi ≤ µBi (j ≤ i ≤ r). Then the Markov-glued pseudometric satisfies Dµ(y, z) ≥ bkEν(z | P). (2.8) The measure ν need not be symmetric.
